_meta.description: One anchor (reference yardstick) per category. All amounts in crore INR at the year stated. The anchor is NOT inflation-adjusted — it is a fixed, named reference point. The display reads: '[item] = N× the [anchor_label]'.

scams.label: India's Annual Union Health Budget
scams.source_label: Economic Times Health, citing Union Budget 2024-25
scams.note: Total Union health budgetary allocation for FY 2024-25: ₹90,958.63 crore. The FY 2025-26 allocation was raised 9.7% to ~₹99,000 crore. Does not include state health budgets.
